headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Airthings Wave / Corentium devices over Bluetooth LE. Protocol based on the [official Airthings BLE library](https://github.com/Airthings/airthings-ble).
footerDisplay: Requires BlueZ (D-Bus) and a working Bluetooth adapter — uses node-ble, not raw HCI. On Raspberry Pi, ensure the Homebridge user can access org.bluez. Radon is exposed via custom characteristics and mapped to HomeKit Air Quality.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to connect and poll each device (min 5 minutes). Longer intervals reduce battery use.

scanDuration.title: Scan duration (seconds)
scanDuration.description: How long to scan for Airthings devices at startup.

isMetric.title: Metric units for radon
isMetric.description: When true, radon is reported in Bq/m³. When false, pCi/L.

co2AlertThreshold.title: CO₂ alert threshold (ppm)
co2AlertThreshold.description: HomeKit Carbon Dioxide Detected is abnormal when CO₂ is at or above this level. Devices do not expose a threshold over BLE.

hciDeviceId.title: Bluetooth adapter ID
hciDeviceId.description: BlueZ adapter index (hci0 = 0). Use the same value as other BLE plugins so they share one adapter lock around scan/connect.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Optional. Restrict to these devices. Serial number is the HomeKit identity; Bluetooth address is only used to find the device. Leave empty to auto-discover all nearby Airthings sensors.

serialNumber.title: Serial number
serialNumber.description: Airthings serial number from the packaging / manufacturer data. This is the accessory identity.

address.title: Bluetooth address
address.description: MAC address used to find the device when advertisements omit the serial, e.g. aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff. Not a second identity.

radonAlertThreshold.title: Radon alert trigger (Bq/m³)
radonAlertThreshold.description: Optional. Configure both thresholds to enable a High Radon leak sensor on radon devices. Trigger at or above this rolling average, independent of isMetric.

radonAlertResetThreshold.title: Radon alert reset (Bq/m³)
radonAlertResetThreshold.description: Optional. Must be positive and strictly below the trigger; clear at or below this rolling average. Apple controls leak notification wording.
